source_anchor: Identify the literal explicit precision formula p_O used in AppendixB2.2 with the canonical actual centered multivariate Gaussian law of covariance A_O^-1, as equality of measures with the exact Euclidean-volume density. No new Gaussian-law constructor and no density premise. This supplies the law/density interface needed by the already compiled literal mixture transform. Mixture/TV interpretation, sphere/Poisson and main lower bounds are separate.

proposed_signatures.gaussian_law_eq_density:
theorem gaussian_law_eq_density {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹ =
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).withDensity (fun x =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
          (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
            Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
              (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)))
proposed_signatures.multivariateGaussian_eq_withDensity_of_p:
theorem multivariateGaussian_eq_withDensity_of_posDef {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A⁻¹ =
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).withDensity (fun x =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt A.det / (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)))

meaning_definitions.multivariateGaussian: Existing Mathlib canonical law (stdGaussian E).map (fun x => mean + Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt covariance) x). Here mean is zero and covariance the actual nonsingular inverse A^-1, to be justified internally.
meaning_definitions.stdGaussian: Existing canonical finite-dimensional standard Gaussian: pushforward of independent scalar standard gaussianReal coordinates in the canonical orthonormal basis.
meaning_definitions.inverse: Matrix nonsingular inverse has a total fallback on singular matrices, but this source case must prove PosDef/invertibility internally; no singular/default law is accepted as source covariance.
meaning_definitions.density: ENNReal.ofReal of the exact real formula sqrt(det A)/(2pi)^(real n/2) exp(-coord x dot(A*coord x)/2), relative to actual Euclidean volume.
meaning_definitions.space: Actual EuclideanSpace R (Fin n), true Euclidean norm, WithLp.ofLp coordinates. Real n/2 and nonnegative real square root.

SOURCE: every actual full orthogonal matrix O
TYPING: canonical centered multivariate Gaussian, Euclidean volume, finite real matrices
